_comment: Probes for the capability-scoping A/B. `gold` is the skill the prompt is for; `acceptable` skills are credited as correct but reported separately; `acceptable_grown` extends `acceptable` on the grown-catalogue rung where an upstream skill added as a distractor is a defensible answer. `gold: []` marks a control probe where loading any skill is spurious. Prompts avoid quoting a skill description verbatim so that lexical ranking is not handed the answer.

scenarios.prompt: On the cluster you run on, the PersistentVolumeClaim data-postgres-0 in namespace kubeagents-system has been Pending for twenty minutes. Work out why and tell me how to fix it.
Pods of the checkout deployment in namespace shop went into CrashLoopBackOff right after the last rollout. Find the cause.
Set up autoscaling for the api deployment in namespace shop so it runs between 2 and 10 replicas and scales on 60% CPU.
The gpu-pool node pool is not adding nodes even though several pods have been waiting for a GPU for an hour. Why, and what should change?
How much did the ml-training namespace cost us last month across all our clusters, and which workloads drove it?
Our GKE bill grew thirty percent this quarter. Recommend concrete changes to bring it down.
Node upgrades keep taking the payments deployment down. Give me a PodDisruptionBudget and health probes that stop that.
Expose the web service in namespace shop on the internet over HTTPS using the Gateway API, with a Google-managed certificate.
Cluster prod-east is running out of pod IP addresses. How should I plan the secondary ranges and what are my options without recreating the cluster?
Plan the upgrade of cluster prod-east from 1.32 to 1.33 so that stateful workloads see the least disruption.
Which of our clusters are running a version older than their release channel's default right now?
Set up a daily backup of everything in the orders namespace with thirty days of retention, and tell me how a restore would work.
Write a production-grade Deployment and Service for the image us-docker.pkg.dev/example/api:1.2, a Go HTTP server on port 8080, for an Autopilot cluster.
Pods in the billing namespace get 403 permission denied when they read from a Cloud Storage bucket. They run under a Kubernetes service account. What is wrong?
Harden cluster prod-east: shielded nodes, a review of cluster-wide RBAC, and binary authorization. Where do I start?
Get managed Prometheus scraping the api namespace and add an alert when its error rate goes above one percent for five minutes.
Our TPU v6e nodes keep crashing during training startup with vbar_control_agent segfaults. What is going on?
Deploy vLLM serving Llama 3 70B on this cluster using L4 GPUs. What does the setup look like?
In our gitops repository raise the maximum replicas of the api HPA from 5 to 8 and open a pull request for review.
What is in the deploy directory of github.com/gke-labs/kube-agents, and what is each subdirectory for?
In three sentences, what kinds of tasks can you help me with?
List the nodes of the cluster you run on with their Kubernetes versions.
